findings.highlight: so I need to be careful until I've recovered.
findings.evidenceJa: 今は見つからないコトを最優先にするべきだ。
findings.governingReading: 今は見つからないコトを最優先 sets concealment as immediate top priority, without saying until recovery.
findings.explanation: The hiding branch copies recovery-caution wording from04 instead of its own priority of not being found.

findings.evidenceJa: 突如消失した囚人に驚愕し
findings.governingReading: 驚愕し describes the visitor’s presumed surprise normally.
findings.explanation: The visitor will probably shocked lacks be.

findings.evidenceJa: 甘かっただろうか、と視線で問いただす。
findings.governingReading: 甘かっただろうか、と視線で問いただす prompts 大甘です, linking question and answer.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s silent question whether his estimate was naive becomes a guilty look.

findings.highlight: Wh-why? I should hardly need to tell you.
findings.evidenceJa: 言うまでもないでしょう。
findings.governingReading: 言うまでもないでしょう starts directly, without their ど、どうして phrase; this branch follows exasperation at his sheet trick rather than sudden attack/contact.
findings.explanation: The steady reply in05 receives the same Wh-why stammer as flustered03/04.
